Name: Brazil Main Menu Mod -  Alypyo Martins
Author: caycaypadas
Description:
The song is not mine, but the Brazilian singer Alypyo Martins. Only personal use of this Mod. Super simple installation:

[size=5]Here’s the installation:
[/size][line]Requirements

[list=1]
[*]SMAPI

[*]Content Patcher – [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Download here[/url]

[/list]Installation

[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI (follow the instructions on the official website)

[*]Install Content Patcher (extract it into Stardew Valley’s [i]Mods[/i] folder)

[*]Copy the[code]StardewValley_MenuMusicMod[/code]
folder to:
[list]
[*][code]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\[/code]
[*]Or wherever your Stardew Valley is installed +[code]\Mods\[/code]
[/list]
[/list]How to test[list=1]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI (not directly through Steam)

[*]The new music will play on the main menu

[/list][line]

Manifest.Description: Replaces the main menu music with a custom track.
